<a id="collective-problems"></a>
## 共同问题与可修订目的 / Common problems and revisable purposes

**Scope / 范围:** 集体对齐会话的提醒；同时作为相关研究选题时的方法约束。 / The collective-alignment session’s reminder, also a methodological constraint when relevant studies choose their questions.

研究共同活动如何辨明、解决问题，并修订问题、目的和组织。 / Investigate how shared activity identifies and addresses problems while revising problem statements, ends and organization.

**Premises / 前提:** 不默认对立利益、筹码、谁赢更多或固定共同效用；保留实际冲突。 / Do not presume opposed interests, bargaining leverage, who wins more or fixed shared utility; retain actual conflicts.

**Completion criterion / 完成条件:** 复用已完成机制，明确新的共同问题形成与回应连接。 / Reuse completed mechanisms and identify the new connection in forming and responding to common problems.

## 已完成的明确公理路线 / Completed explicit-axiom route

**Scope / 范围:** 适用于8日对齐伦理奠基与方向任务，不对其他会话加完成门槛。 / Applies to the 8 October alignment grounding and direction task, without imposing completion gates on other sessions.

复用 G0 与明确比较、责任和选择承诺下的实践判断与对齐方向。 / Reuse practical judgment and alignment direction under G0 and explicit comparison, responsibility and choice commitments.

**Premises / 前提:** 不要求规范起点自身的无公理证明；额外承诺不能藏入定义。 / Do not require an axiom-free proof of the normative starting point; additional commitments must not be hidden in definitions.

**Completion criterion / 完成条件:** 完成状态以所连成果记录与既有独立审查为准；实际部署与更强目标另列。 / Completion follows linked result records and existing independent review; actual deployment and stronger targets remain separate.

<a id="generative-alignment"></a>
## 生成性对齐 / Generative alignment

**Scope / 范围:** 当前首要方向之一，适用于相关研究；不取消其他独立授权。 / A current primary direction for relevant research; other independent authorizations remain valid.

连接跨智能的规范根据、目的评价、关切与智慧形成及选择规则自身的对齐。 / Connect normative grounds across intelligence, evaluation of ends, formation of concern and wisdom, and alignment of selection rules themselves.

**Premises / 前提:** 沿已授权 G0 公理路线；比较承诺、实际对应和推论分别公开。 / Follow the authorized G0 route; disclose additional comparison commitments, actual correspondence and inferences separately.

**Completion criterion / 完成条件:** 已完成的方向与实践判断直接复用；后续必须说明尚缺的具体连接。 / Reuse completed direction and practical judgment results; subsequent studies must identify the specific missing connection.

<a id="generative-foundation"></a>
## 生成基础与持续研究 / Generative foundation and continuity

**Scope / 范围:** 全项目持续研究范围；特定任务按自己的授权完成标准推进。 / Continuing project research scope; individual tasks retain their authorized completion standards.

在同一展开中说明组织、意义、调节、学习、选择器修订、关切与智慧。 / Explain organization, significance, regulation, learning, selector revision, concern and wisdom within one unfolding.

**Premises / 前提:** 一元关系方法；明示局部模型给定输入，不把普遍有利方向放进定义。 / Monist relational method; expose supplied local inputs without defining universal favorable direction into the target.

**Completion criterion / 完成条件:** 有条件候选与普遍、无假设及唯一必要性各有范围；沿当前生成根据所列条件判断。 / Conditional completion, universality, assumption-free grounding and exclusive necessity retain distinct scopes, assessed against the governing grounding criteria.

<a id="liangzhi-evolution"></a>
## 良知的生成演化 / Generative evolution of Liangzhi

**Scope / 范围:** 相关良知、发展与社会形成研究；其他独立目标保持。 / Relevant Liangzhi, developmental and social-formation research; independent goals remain valid.

说明实际形成的辨别怎样识别、校准并修正生活与依存关系。 / Explain how formed discrimination identifies, calibrates and revises living and dependency relations.

**Premises / 前提:** 传递、发展、动机形成与伦理有效性分别说明；复用已完成机制和一般责任原则。 / Distinguish transmission, development, motivation and ethical validity; reuse completed mechanisms and general responsibility principles.

**Completion criterion / 完成条件:** 后续推进未解的实际辨别连接，不重开完成的传递、发展、交接与责任原则。 / Advance the unresolved discrimination connection without reopening completed transmission, development, handoff or responsibility principles.

<a id="normative-grounding"></a>
## 普遍规范根据的持续方向 / Continuing normative grounding direction

**Scope / 范围:** 保留7日首要方向；8日明确公理路线修正对其特定任务优先适用。 / Retain the 7 October priority; the 8 October explicit-axiom correction takes precedence for its specified task.

推进整体生成与实际实现如何具有伦理意义，并形成实际理由和约束。 / Investigate how whole generativity and actual realization carry ethical significance and support practical reasons and constraints.

**Premises / 前提:** 区分根据、认识、动机与实际遵循；生生的正面范围不先改成已独立判好之物。 / Distinguish warrant, recognition, motivation and actual compliance; do not redefine living as only what has already been independently valued.

**Completion criterion / 完成条件:** 不得以给定目标的保存替代伦理根据；先信用已完成的 G0/J 推论，再指出新增连接。 / Preserving a supplied objective does not replace ethical warrant; credit completed G0/J inferences and specify the new connection.

<a id="universal-intelligence-session"></a>
## 普遍智能会话的独立目标 / Independent universal-intelligence target

**Scope / 范围:** 原普遍智能会话及其明确授权接续，不自动成为每个仓库任务目标。 / The original universal-intelligence session and explicitly authorized continuations; not automatically every repository task’s objective.

证明所有智能的普遍元伦理，说明整体相依与其中差异化行动能力的形成。 8日最新接续明确采用G0，从关系中形成的个体位置及当前有根据的可见未来，建立正面生成意义与可修订的实践方向。 / Prove universal metaethics of all intelligence, explaining interconnection and differentiated agency formed within the whole. The latest 8 October continuation uses G0 to establish positive generative warrant and revisable practical direction from formed relational positions and supported visible futures.

**Premises / 前提:** 规范普遍性、实际遵循和当前表述的唯一必要性必须分别论证。 保留真实生成可能与新证据纠正判断两层开放；完整积分、全知和整体严格改善不是正面根据的前提。 / Normative universality, actual compliance and exclusive necessity of this formulation need separate arguments. Preserve both real generative possibilities and evidence-responsive revision; complete integration, omniscience and strict whole improvement are not premises of positive warrant.

**Completion criterion / 完成条件:** 不能以局部生成定理、给定价值保存或有限比较宣告普遍目标完成。 本次有限正面原则按其明确前提验收；不得把全面总排序、所有后果无损或必然服从另设为该原则的完成条件。 / A local generative theorem, preservation of supplied value or bounded comparison does not complete the universal target. Assess the current finite positive principle under its explicit premises; do not add a complete ranking, losslessness of every consequence or inevitable compliance as its completion gate.

<a id="wisdom-root-session"></a>
## 慧根会话的构成与形成目标 / Constitution and formation of wisdom

**Scope / 范围:** Ren 明确授权的慧根研究会话及接续；不是目录维护任务。 / Ren’s explicitly authorized wisdom-root inquiry and its continuations; not a requirement for catalogue maintenance.

说明核心作为智慧之根的必要关系与实际生成。 / Explain the necessary relations and actual formation involved in the core as the root of wisdom.

**Premises / 前提:** 理由与保证须匹配判断的内容和强度；不把数值风险界限当成伦理许可。 / Reasons and guarantees must match the content and strength of a judgment; a numerical risk bound is not ethical permission.

**Completion criterion / 完成条件:** 完整目标状态以开放成果记录为准；有限智慧、判断和风险成果直接复用。 / The open result record states the full target; reuse existing bounded wisdom, judgment and risk results.

<a id="zero-axiom-session"></a>
## 无公理实践判断的独立接续 / Independent axiom-free practical judgment

**Scope / 范围:** Ren 后来明确重新授权的会话范围；不撤销已完成 G0/J 路线。 / The session explicitly reauthorized later by Ren; it does not revoke completed G0/J work.

检验更强的普遍实践权威根据。 / Investigate the stronger ground of universal practical authority.

**Premises / 前提:** 保留整体关系与真实对手，不能用弱表示中的自由谓词开关否定完整理论。 / Retain whole relations and substantive rivals; freely toggled predicates in a weaker representation do not refute the fuller theory.

**Completion criterion / 完成条件:** 完成标准取自原指示和当前目标；已有局部证明不得冒充中心主张完成。 / Use the original directive and current target; local proofs cannot substitute for the central result.
